title: Affine generators of effective Cartier ideals are regular
statement: Let X be a scheme and J an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. Let V be an affine open and c a section of its structure sheaf. If J(V) = (c), then c is a nonzerodivisor in Γ(V, O_X).

proof.text: At each point of V choose an affine neighborhood on which J has a regular generator d, then a common basic open in both neighborhoods. Flatness of restriction preserves regularity of d. The restricted c and d generate the same principal ideal, so c is regular there as well: if c r = 0 and d = c t, then d r = 0 and hence r = 0. A section r of V killed by c therefore vanishes on a neighborhood of every point, so the sheaf condition gives r = 0 on V. This includes the empty affine open, whose zero ring satisfies the same implication.
